info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Billing Update API
info.description: This API facilitates updates to customer billing information, enabling businesses to maintain accurate and up-to-date payment records. Users can modify details such as billing addresses, payment methods, and subscription statuses. Typical consumers include financial departments and customer service teams that manage client accounts. By implementing this API, organizations can enhance their billing processes and improve customer satisfaction.

patch.description: This operation allows you to modify the billing information for a specific customer identified by their unique ID. Provide the necessary details in the request body to update the customer's billing records.

requestBody.description: This request is used to update billing information for the specified customer. The body should contain the necessary fields to modify the billing details as needed.

200.description: Request completed successfully with updated billing information.
